# Aerie Peak unused mobs

## Post 10728 by Helsinki — 2021-05-30T17:00:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=10728#p10728 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

Seems that Blizzard wanted Aerie Peak vendors in their 1.13 patch, but they did not make it in the game, here is the list of those NPC's:
[Aerie Peak Mail Armor Vendor](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=12040/aerie-peak-mail-armor-vendor%20url)
[Aerie Peak Meat Vendor](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=12039/aerie-peak-meat-vendor%20url)
[Aerie Peak Mining Trainer](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=12035/aerie-peak-mining-trainer%20url)
[Aerie Peak General Goods](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=12036/aerie-peak-general-goods%20url)

In the current state besides the quartermaster, bartender and leatherworking supplies and trainer NPC's the base feels empty, having those above mentioned vendors could be nice as there is a troll maze in the zone and every one of us needs to resupply every now and then while questing and leveling there.

What are your thoughts about having those NPC's in Aerie Peak, let me hear your opinions ?

## Post 10734 by Lexi (Barrens Chat Casualty) — 2021-05-31T05:54:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=10734#p10734 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

I'd like to see them added, but I don't think it should be a high priority or anything. If you really want them to be added, adding to them with the npc maker might increase their chances of being added in the near future.
